facts.value: Entry stores the Master Hand lookup result in Fighter.x1A5C and enters motion 0x179. Animation queries shared predicates and remaining frames; on exit it calls Fighter_UnkSetFlag_8006CFBC, clears x1A5C, and forwards the object to ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015BC88. IASA classifies player_id and conditionally forwards the object for human slots. Physics delegates X/Y self-velocity assignments from animation translation; collision ignores its argument.

facts.value: Entry unconditionally requests motion 0x179 with zero flags and floating arguments 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f. Animation short-circuits across two partner predicates and animation exhaustion; a true exit condition invokes the fighter flag helper, clears x1A5C, then initiates the handoff. Otherwise it performs no local mutation. IASA invokes an empty boss hook only for human slots; physics always delegates; collision is a no-op.
